levels.surface: إسحاق بن إبراهيم بن حبيب بن الشهيد

notes: «ح» joins two isnads for the same ruling; each writes different names, so there is no shared tail
«قال سمعت أبي» is Mu'tamir's father, not named here: not identified with سليمان التيمي (rule 9)
Branch 1 ends at سليمان التيمي as the text writes it; the Companion appears only in branch 2
